items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: I auditioned for his band in the very early 50s, like right after I got out of high school.

ctx.x: Yeah, and I tell you, I liked that too. Well back to your neighborhood. You said Johnny Ronica lived out there? Johnny Ronica lived on Canal Street but I didn't know him that well.
I auditioned for his band in the very early 50s, like right after I got out of high school. But I couldn't read well enough to play with his band.

items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: I'll tell you who lived out there. It was Johnny Ronica.

ctx.x: He had one of them. And I was just curious about him because he was one of those people that was around.
I'll tell you who lived out there. It was Johnny Ronica.
